verdict.rationale: All evidence describes Slack exposing its own official MCP server so external AI clients (Claude, ChatGPT, custom agents) can call Slack's tools — the reverse direction of this story, which asks whether a user can plug external MCP servers into Slack so Slack's own agents (e.g., Slackbot) can use their tools. No evidence shows Slack acting as an MCP client that consumes third-party MCP servers.
